title: 3DS: Medical Domain Adaptation of LLMs via Decomposed Difficulty-based Data Selection
authors_zh: Hongxin Ding, Yue Fang, Runchuan Zhu, Xinke Jiang, Jinyang Zhang, Yongxin Xu, Weibin Liao, Xu Chu, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang
paper_type_zh: 以模型为中心的领域指令数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 把已知模型适配到带噪专业指令池的读者。
one_line: 3DS filters domain SFT records by target-model quality, decomposed moderate difficulty, and diversity.
3DS 按目标模型质量、分解后的适度难度和多样性过滤领域监督微调记录。
why: It makes target-model knowledge compatibility and learnable difficulty explicit before records are admitted to SFT.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly selects which specialized instruction records enter SFT based on target-model compatibility and multi-axis difficulty.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Specialized instruction corpora can be large, heterogeneous, and noisy. Training a general model on every medical record may reinforce facts it already knows, introduce conflicts, or expose it to language outside its usable knowledge distribution. Selecting only externally judged high-quality or maximally difficult data does not solve this mismatch, because usefulness depends on the target model's state.

3DS asks which domain instruction-response records a specific model should consume for supervised adaptation. It is a selection policy over a 1.9-million-record medical pool, not a new medical generator. The paper seeks data that is first compatible with the target model's knowledge and then moderately challenging along several stages of solving, so the SFT subset supplies learnable domain signals rather than indiscriminate scale.

专业指令语料可能规模很大、来源异质且带噪。在每条医疗记录上训练通用模型，可能强化它已经掌握的事实、引入冲突，或让它接触超出可用知识分布的语言。只选择由外部裁判判为优质或最难的数据也不能解决这种失配，因为有用性取决于目标模型的状态。

3DS 追问某个特定模型在监督适配中应消费哪些领域指令—回答记录。它是在 190 万记录医疗池上的选择策略，而不是新的医疗生成器。论文寻求先与目标模型知识兼容、再沿多个解题阶段具有适度挑战的数据，使监督微调子集提供可学习的领域信号，而非不加区分地扩大规模。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The first stage uses the target model itself as a prompt-based quality rater. Records whose model-generated score clears a high threshold are retained, with the stated purpose of eliminating noisy, redundant, or conflicting information before difficulty selection. This explicit alignment makes compatibility with the target model a prerequisite for admission rather than treating quality as a universal label.

The second stage decomposes difficulty into instruction understanding, confidence in a generated answer, and likelihood of the reference answer. It retains a middle percentile range for every metric rather than only the hardest records, then uses k-center selection over instruction embeddings to preserve diversity. Attention-derived token weights calibrate the two response metrics, making uncertain but semantically important tokens contribute more to the decision about which records enter the 5K SFT budget.

第一阶段把目标模型本身作为基于提示的质量评估器。模型生成分数超过高阈值的记录被保留，论文说明此举是在难度选择前消除噪声、冗余或冲突信息。这种显式对齐让与目标模型的兼容性成为准入前提，而不是把质量视为普适标签。

第二阶段把难度分解为指令理解、对生成回答的置信度和参考回答的似然。它为每个指标保留中间百分位范围，而非只保留最难记录，然后对指令嵌入使用 k-center 选择以保持多样性。由注意力导出的词元权重校准两个回答指标，使不确定但语义重要的词元对哪些记录进入 5K 监督微调预算的决策贡献更大。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a record with instruction and reference answer, 3DS measures instruction-understanding difficulty by prompt perplexity. It generates an answer and measures conditional perplexity for response confidence, then measures conditional perplexity of the reference answer for response correctness. The response scores weight token log probabilities by aggregated attention received from later tokens. These are model-state measurements, so the same record can occupy a different difficulty range for another base model.

Stage one retains target-model quality scores at least 90. Stage two sets per-model lower and upper percentiles on a medical holdout set, keeps examples in the specified middle ranges, and applies k-center sampling to form 5K examples. The main source pool has more than 1.9M Chinese medical records from five named sources. Experiments fine-tune Baichuan2-13B-Chat, Qwen1.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and LLaMA3-8B-Instruct, comparing random, full-data SFT, external scorers, difficulty methods, and gradient similarity selection. The authors release the pool and implementation in their official repository.

对含有指令和参考回答的记录，3DS 用提示困惑度度量指令理解难度。它生成一个回答，以条件困惑度度量回答置信度，再以参考回答的条件困惑度度量回答正确性。回答分数按后续词元接收到的聚合注意力加权词元对数概率。它们是模型状态度量，因此同一记录对另一基础模型可能处于不同难度范围。

第一阶段保留目标模型质量分数至少为 90 的记录。第二阶段在医疗留出集上为每个模型设置下、上百分位，保留指定中间范围的例子，并应用 k-center 抽样形成 5K 例。主来源池含五个命名来源的 190 多万条中文医疗记录。实验微调 Baichuan2-13B-Chat、Qwen1.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 LLaMA3-8B-Instruct，与随机、全数据监督微调、外部评分器、难度方法和梯度相似度选择比较。作者在官方仓库发布数据池和实现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across CMB-Exam and MMCU-Med, the reported average for 3DS is 60.61, above the base average of 58.47, random selection at 57.96, and the strongest listed baseline LESS at 58.86. For Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, it reaches 79.06 on CMB-Exam and 85.70 on MMCU-Med, compared with 78.28 and 83.43 before adaptation. Full SFT on the 1.9M pool drops the average to 51.00, providing direct evidence that more unfiltered domain data is not beneficial in this setting.

On the open medical analysis set CMB-Clin, 3DS reports an average of 35.21 across the listed BLEU and ROUGE metrics, compared with 26.15 for IFD and 26.01 for MoDS. Ablations show that removing the prompt-driven stage or any of the three difficulty components lowers results, and the paper reports low correlations and limited overlap among the three difficulty metrics. Additional experiments report improvements in a legal CaseHOLD setting and on MMLU, but the main evidence remains Chinese medical adaptation with selection thresholds tuned on a CMB holdout set.

在 CMB-Exam 与 MMCU-Med 上，3DS 报告的平均为 60.61，高于基础模型平均 58.47、随机选择 57.96 和所列最强基线 LESS 的 58.86。对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，它在 CMB-Exam 和 MMCU-Med 分别达到 79.06 与 85.70，而适配前为 78.28 与 83.43。在 190 万完整池上的全量监督微调使平均降至 51.00，直接表明在该设置中更多未过滤的领域数据并无益处。

在开放医疗分析集 CMB-Clin 上，3DS 报告所列 BLEU 与 ROUGE 指标平均为 35.21，而 IFD 和 MoDS 分别为 26.15 与 26.01。消融显示去掉提示驱动阶段或三个难度成分中的任一项都会降低结果，论文还报告三个难度指标之间相关性低、重合有限。额外实验报告其在法律 CaseHOLD 设置和 MMLU 上的提升，但主要证据仍是阈值在 CMB 留出集上调节的中文医疗适配。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Many selection pipelines use external quality judges or a single notion of difficulty. 3DS makes both decisions model-centric: the same target model first gates quality and then provides three different signals about what it understands, can answer confidently, and can answer correctly. The important change is not simply a more elaborate perplexity score; it changes the admission rule for domain records according to the learner's distribution.

Its second novelty is to reject two extremes on every difficulty dimension. A record can be linguistically difficult yet have a confident hallucinated answer, or easy to parse yet hard to match to the reference. Decomposing these cases lets the selector seek a middle, learnable region rather than a universal hard set. Diversity is added after the compatibility and difficulty decisions, making the final record set a combination of model alignment, multi-axis trainability, and coverage.

许多选择流程使用外部质量裁判或单一难度概念。3DS 让两类决策都以模型为中心：同一目标模型先筛选质量，再提供它理解什么、能自信回答什么、能正确回答什么的三种不同信号。重要改变不只是更复杂的困惑度分数；它依据学习者分布改变了领域记录的准入规则。

第二个新意是在每个难度维度拒绝两个极端。一条记录可能在语言上困难，却得到自信的幻觉回答；也可能容易解析，却难以与参考答案匹配。分解这些情形让选择器寻找中间的可学习区域，而非普适的困难集合。多样性在兼容性和难度决策之后加入，使最终记录集结合模型对齐、多轴可训练性和覆盖。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method rates the entire training corpus before fine-tuning, which is costly for a 1.9M-record pool and may limit use on even larger datasets. It is a pre-training selection rather than an online adaptive schedule, so the model's changing capability after SFT is not used to revise the subset. Thresholds are tuned on a medical holdout set and differ across model families, which reduces out-of-the-box portability. The central evidence uses Chinese medical data and automatic lexical metrics for one open-answer task; although law and general-domain tests are included, broader languages, safety requirements, and subjective expert-quality judgments remain insufficiently established.
该方法在微调前对完整训练语料评分，对 190 万记录池成本很高，可能限制其在更大数据集上的使用。它是训练前选择而非在线自适应调度，因此模型在监督微调后的能力变化不会用于修订子集。阈值在医疗留出集上调节，且不同模型家族不同，降低了开箱即用的可移植性。核心证据使用中文医疗数据，并对一个开放回答任务采用自动词汇指标；尽管包含法律和通用领域测试，更广语言、安全要求和主观专家质量判断仍未充分确立。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use 3DS when adapting a known target model to a specialized instruction pool that has reference answers and when moderate, model-relative difficulty is preferable to maximum difficulty. Preserve the prompt-based rating template and threshold, base checkpoint and tokenizer, three perplexity definitions, attention aggregation, percentile bounds, embedding and k-center configuration, selected IDs, and holdout protocol. Compare with random and full-pool SFT at the same 5K budget, and audit any medical content for clinical safety, provenance, personal data, and license before reuse. The official repository is the appropriate source for the released pool and implementation, not a substitute for those checks.

当把已知目标模型适配到含参考答案的专业指令池，且模型相对的适度难度优于最大难度时，可使用 3DS。应保留基于提示的评分模板与阈值、基础检查点和分词器、三个困惑度定义、注意力聚合、百分位边界、嵌入与 k-center 配置、所选标识和留出协议。应在相同 5K 预算下与随机和全池监督微调比较，并在复用前审计任何医疗内容的临床安全、来源、个人数据和许可证。官方仓库是发布数据池和实现的适当来源，却不能替代这些检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The two stages answer different questions: first, whether the target model should trust a record enough to consider it; second, whether that record lies in a productive rather than trivial or overwhelming difficulty region. The three difficulty scores should not be collapsed mentally into ordinary response loss, because one is prompt-only and another uses the model's own generated answer. The full-data degradation is a useful caution, but the selected 5K performance also depends on a medical holdout used for thresholds, so a reproduction should separate the general selection principle from its domain-specific calibration.
两个阶段回答不同问题：首先目标模型是否足够信任一条记录以考虑它；其次该记录是否处于有效而非轻松或压倒性的难度区域。三个难度分数不应在概念上合并为普通回答损失，因为一个仅处理提示，另一个使用模型自己生成的回答。全数据退化是有用警告，但所选 5K 的表现也取决于用于阈值的医疗留出集，因此复现应把一般选择原理和领域特定校准分开。
